entries.description: Read spec, planning docs, and Orders-related code; identified that jdoe signs into the internal org as BackofficeUser and ApplyRowFilter returns Where(_=>false) when ActiveOrganizationId.HasValue and CustomerId is null.

Traced row-filter pipeline: IRowFilterService is registered but unused; OrderService.ApplyRowFilter hardcodes logic that filters by CustomerId when any ActiveOrganizationId is set, regardless of role. CurrentUserService.Role returns highest role from claims.
Confirmed rule from config and role description: Customer -> own orders only; BackofficeUser and above -> all orders. Matches security-config.json RowFilters which only scopes the Customer role.

Rewrote OrderService.ApplyRowFilter to key off role only: Role >= BackofficeUser -> pass-through; Customer with CustomerId -> filter; Customer with no CustomerId -> deny-all. Removes the ActiveOrganizationId.HasValue branch that caused the bug.
Added tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Tests/OrderVisibilityTests.cs with three real-DB cases: BackofficeUser jdoe sees total order count; Customer sees only own orders; SystemAdmin sees all.
Added OrdersList_AsBackofficeUser_ShowsSeededOrdersAsync to OrdersWorkflowTests.cs exercising the drawer-driven nav as jdoe.

dotnet build: success (0 warnings, 0 errors). dotnet test: 561 passed; one pre-existing failure (WorkflowAssetSmokeTests.AiRouterConfig_LoadsNestedPromptTemplates references docs/workflow-auth-observability.md which was removed in commit 8730107 and is unrelated to this session). All 3 new OrderVisibilityTests pass.
Cross-provider verification via router (model: opus); raw review saved.
